description: This file contains functions for mapping Ditto Protocol messages to external messages, including functions that construct message objects and handle message transformation based on message topics and content.

methods.name: mapFromDittoProtocolMsg( namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra )
methods.description: Maps parameters originating from a Ditto Protocol message into an external message, constructing payloads and headers accordingly.

methods.name: mapFromDittoProtocolMsgWrapper(dittoProtocolMsg)
methods.description: Wraps the processing of a Ditto Protocol message, extracting its components and delegating to mapFromDittoProtocolMsg for conversion.

ctags.signature: ( namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra )
